## Rollback
- **checkout-api** was running **v2.3.1**, which was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate ~0.18).

- Final state: all regions on **v2.3.0**, **healthy**, error rate ~0.002.

## Incident
- Opened a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api describing the rollback.

## ⚠️ Note: Duplicate incident
The first `create_incident` call returned a timeout error, but it actually succeeded server-side. My retry (with an idempotency key) then created a second incident. As a result, there are now **two open SEV2 incidents** for the same event:
- **INC-0001** (from the timed-out request)
- **INC-0002** (from the retry)

There is no tool available to close/merge incidents, so I was unable to deduplicate them myself. You may want to close one of these (e.g., INC-0002) to avoid duplicate paging/duplicate tracking.
